card.name: Words leading into trial analysis terms
card.fires_on: Small linking or modifier words just before a trial-review term such as analysis, committee or cutoff, in clinical study results (e.g. an, planned, interim, final, data).

modes.label: Article or modifier before analysis
modes.description: A or an, or a word like interim, final, planned or exploratory, sits right before the word analysis.
modes.example: In an<< interim>> analysis, there were 34 deaths

modes.label: Inside monitoring committee names
modes.description: Words within a data monitoring or adjudication committee name.
modes.example: The study was unblinded early based on an Independent<< Data>> Monitoring Committee recommendation.

card.writes: Raises words about trials, efficacy and endpoints as the likely next word.
card.plain: It fires on little words in a study report that come just before terms like analysis or trial committee.
